body: A landing page can bring in new clients — or new staff. Pick your field and it gets specific.

detail.headline: Your firm covers eight practice areas. The client has one.
detail.outcome: One page per situation that names the case, explains the process and makes the enquiry easy.
problems: Someone who just got a termination letter isn't looking for a law firm — they want help with that one case.
What the first consultation costs and how it works is nowhere to be found. So nobody calls.

detail.headline: Anyone who needs an expert report has never needed one before.
detail.outcome: A page that explains in plain language when a report is needed — and who pays for it.
problems: After an accident that wasn't your fault, you may choose your own appraiser — almost nobody knows this.
With no detail on process, duration or cost, hiring one feels like a risk.

detail.headline: Enquiries aren't the problem. The right ones are.
detail.outcome: A page for one ideal client profile that filters out the wrong enquiries up front.
problems: Your firm's site speaks to everyone — so mostly the cases you don't want get in touch.
The clients you do want can't tell that you have handled their industry many times over.

detail.headline: The work is there. The people aren't.
detail.outcome: A page that shows how you actually work — and lets someone apply in two minutes.
problems: Your job ad sits between 40 others — and looks like all of them.
Anyone who is interested finds nothing about the company, the team or the daily work.

detail.headline: Being found isn't enough.
detail.outcome: A page that works on a phone and takes enquiries around the clock.
problems: Google sends visitors to a page that hasn't changed in years.
Enquiries only work by phone, during office hours. In the evening people click on.

detail.headline: The decision maker has three tabs open.
detail.outcome: A page that shows the offer, the difference and the next step at a glance.
problems: Your website explains your company. They are looking for the answer to their problem.
What sets you apart from the other two providers, they have to work out themselves.

outcomeLabel: What the page then has to do
title: See yourself in here?
